about_the_game:
Kieta Memory – The Girl from the Stars

If your memories don't die – will you live forever?
Without our memories – who are we?

About This Game

Welcome to 1992 – a year of miracles, love, and cosmic mysteries that will change your life forever.

In Kieta Memory – The Girl from the Stars, you'll experience an unforgettable romance that transcends the boundaries of time and space. Meet Azuki, your extraordinary girlfriend who isn't quite from this world. She's literally a girl from the stars, and through her, you'll discover a universe far stranger and more wonderful than you ever imagined.

A Summer of Love and Wonder

Immerse yourself in the quirky, heartwarming world of Azuki's star-human family. Get to know her energetic little sister who brightens every scene, her enigmatic parents harboring cosmic secrets, and Marvin – the family's sarcastic house robot who's equal parts helpful and hilariously snappy. Every interaction reveals new layers of this extraordinary family dynamic.

But this isn't just a slice-of-life romance. As your perfect summer of love reaches its peak, dark forces emerge from the shadows. Political conspiracies and hidden agendas take Azuki away from you, setting in motion events that will determine the very fate of Earth itself.

An Epic Journey Through Time and Space

When your young love seems lost, you'll embark on an adventure that spans dimensions and decades. Navigate complex relationships, uncover cosmic conspiracies, and make choices that ripple across the fabric of reality itself.

Along the way, you'll be joined by loyal friends who'll stand by your side through impossible odds. Together, you'll face challenges that test not just your courage, but your very understanding of love, memory, and what it means to be human.

Key Features:

  • Branching narrative with multiple paths and endings

  • Rich character development featuring a diverse cast of humans, star-beings, and one unforgettable robot

  • Time-spanning storyline that weaves romance, science fiction, and political intrigue

  • Multiple relationship options – discover new love while honoring the past

  • Stunning artwork bringing the cosmic romance to life

  • Memorable soundtrack that captures both intimate moments and epic space adventures

The Power of Choice

Every decision matters in Kieta Memory. Will you fight to reclaim your memories of Azuki, or will you forge a new path? Can you save Earth while staying true to your heart? The future isn't written in the stars – it's written by you.

Perfect for fans of: Romantic visual novels, science fiction stories, time travel narratives, and anyone who believes in the power of love and humanity.

Main characters


 Azuki
Your girl from the stars. At least, that's where her parents are from. Azuki was born in Japan. Now she struggles to adapt to life in Germany and wishes nothing more than leaving Earth behind.

Patti
The high-energy girl, full of passion for physics. Even though she lets a few pieces of equipment go up in flames along the way, she'll become a famous physicist one day – what else?

Marie
Marie grew up on a picturesque farm in the Alps. Her talent was evident even in elementary school – so much so that her teachers let her skip two grades. That helped ease the boredom. But life as a young prodigy also has its downsides, a reason for her shyness...

Sylvia
Baronesse Sylvia of Tensberg – that's how she likes to be addressed. However, after making friends with Azuki, Marie, Patti, and you, her pride lost a bit of importance to her. Still, she's always in for a snappy remark when there's a chance.

Kiki
Azuki's little sister. On the same energy level with Patti, she is a young genius that knows more about science and technology than most adults, plus a few things that only star humans know. This and video games keep her busy and let her forget that not everything is easy in her life...

Marvin
The robot in Azuki's family. Diligently taking care of mundane tasks, he still has enough time to spend playing electric guitar or having a friendly banter with the other family members.

short_description: A romantic sci-fi visual novel starting in 1992. Life with your girlfriend Azuki, the girl from the stars, is fun, but when cosmic conspiracies threaten your love and all of Earth, you and your friends have to embark on an epic journey through time and space and rewrite your future.
